unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/cura-pilot-vuh7p781.service
[Unit]
Description=Cura Agrorum receiver
Wants=cura-pilot-rtc-vuh7p781.service
After=local-fs.target cura-pilot-rtc-vuh7p781.service
RequiresMountsFor=/var/lib/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/config /var/lib/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/data /var/lib/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/data/tmp /opt/cura-pilot-vuh7p781
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
User=cura-receiver
Group=cura-receiver
SupplementaryGroups=gpio spi
EnvironmentFile=/var/lib/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/config/deployment.env
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/opt/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/receiver:/opt/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/protocol/protocol-v2-lora/python
ExecStartPre=/opt/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/venv/bin/python -m cura_receiver.storage_preflight
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemd-inhibit --what=sleep --mode=block --who=cura-receiver --why=Receiver-clock-and-radio-deadlines /opt/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/venv/bin/python -m cura_receiver --rtc-helper-sha256 ${RTC_HELPER_SHA256} --rtc-kernel-bound-us ${RTC_KERNEL_BOUND_US}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=15
KillMode=control-group
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_SYS_TIME
AmbientCapabilities=
NoNewPrivileges=no
UMask=0077
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/cura-pilot-vuh7p781/data

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
scope: Read-only tracking; no makestep, receiver start, or RF operation.
